brief: 5 morning rituals that changed how I run my business.

slots.headline: Five Morning Rituals That Changed My Business

slots.title: No Phone Zone
slots.body: I don't touch my phone for the first sixty minutes. It protects my focus and lets me set the day's agenda instead of reacting to everyone else's. That single boundary changed my energy completely.

slots.title: Move Before Email
slots.body: A twenty-minute walk or stretch clears mental fog. Movement boosts decision-making stamina before I sit down to lead. I show up sharper and far less reactive.

slots.title: One Deep Block
slots.body: I dedicate ninety minutes to my hardest priority before meetings begin. Protecting this slot means my most important work actually gets done. Everything else fits around it.

slots.title: Journal Three Lines
slots.body: Three lines of reflection reveal patterns I would otherwise miss. It takes two minutes but prevents costly repeated mistakes. Clarity is a competitive advantage.

slots.title: Protein First
slots.body: A high-protein breakfast stabilizes my blood sugar and mood. No mid-morning crash means consistent judgment through back-to-back calls. Food is focus fuel.

slots.title: Pick One Today
slots.body: You don't need all six to see results. Choose the ritual that feels easiest and practice it for one week. Small mornings build empires.
